protocol.kind: illustrative synthetic simulation (not apartment-specific, not a bill)
protocol.apartment: simulation/plant.py DEFAULT_PARAMS (10,000 L tank, 3,000 L reserve, 1,000 L critical, 2.2 kW pump moving 6,000 L/h, 3.3 kW charger, 6 kW participating-load allowance, min on/off 4/2 intervals)
protocol.profile: simulation/plant.py default_withdrawals (synthetic; identical every day: no weekday/weekend/holiday differentiation exists in the profile, so none is modelled; each day weighted equally)
protocol.advisory_note: 10:00-13:00 IST every day; advisory hours carry no bill value under LT-1 (no time-of-day tariff)
protocol.ev: one EV per day, arriving 00:00, leaving 08:00 (intervals 0-32), requested energy per scenario
protocol.execution: perfect human execution except base_missed_ev (15% of instructed EV actions skipped, reported done)
protocol.seed: day d of scenario s uses seed 7000 + 100*s + d (s in declaration order)

comparability.storage: final tank difference converted to pump energy at 2.2 kW per 6,000 L/h and reported as a storage-adjusted energy difference; raw difference also shown

comparison.comparability: comparable (equal water and EV service; storage difference credited)

comparison.time_shifting_note: LT-1 has one flat energy rate (no time-of-day tariff): moving the same kWh between hours changes the energy charge by exactly zero.
comparison.fppca_effect: unknown: storage-adjusted kWh difference x the month's FPPCA rate (no verified value)
comparison.demand_charge_effect: not estimable: needs the whole connection's recorded maximum demand; participating-load meters cannot supply it and the participating-load allowance is not sanctioned load or contract demand
comparison.verdict: zero within rounding: the whole difference is baseline overflow, a 15-minute modelling artefact
